cards.title: Working Parents: School Holidays Should Be Joyful
cards.body: Balancing work and parenting creates constant logistical challenges, especially during school holidays. Emily Mulligan argues we should reimagine school schedules to give families quality time together without work distractions.

cards.title: Halloween Magic: Creating Connection With Your Kids
cards.body: Rather than cynicism, Iman Amrani is embracing Halloween as a moment of magic and connection for her family. From Day of the Dead to Samhain, celebrating autumn has centuries-old roots worth rekindling.

cards.title: Boomer Parents and Millennial Daughters Miscommunicate
cards.body: Three everyday phrases reveal why loving parents and adult daughters often misunderstand each other. Hidden emotional labor can turn connection into conflict between generations.

cards.title: Stop Waiting for Perfect to Praise Your Child
cards.body: Reinforce smaller behaviors along the way rather than waiting for your child to do exactly what you want. Praising incremental progress makes reaching ultimate goals more likely.

cards.title: Are You Raising Bonsai Trees or Wildflowers?
cards.body: Parents can respect their children's growing ambitions even when unsure whether to nurture, challenge, or let go. Understanding your parenting approach helps support your child's unique development.

cards.title: Why ADHD Stimulants Wear Off Just Before Homework
cards.body: Many ADHD medications wear off exactly when children need them most for homework. Individualized treatment planning is essential since one-size-fits-all approaches don't work for ADHD management.

cards.title: Family Medical History: Why Adopted Kids Need It
cards.body: Adopted children and those in care often struggle to access crucial family medical history. This information can be vital to understanding and managing their own health.

cards.title: Autism, ADHD and Mental Health: Key Policy Lessons
cards.body: A major review contains important lessons for NHS, welfare, education and employment policies. Understanding these takeaways helps shape better support for children with these conditions.

cards.title: Questions Before Cutting Off Family Members
cards.body: One in five UK families experience permanent estrangement, and this decision shouldn't be made lightly. Experts suggest asking yourself key questions before cutting a relative out of your life.
